checks.name: epigraph_midpoint_certificate
checks.claim: For f(x) = (x - 0.1)^2 + 0.2, the chord value at the displayed mixture is above the graph.

checks.name: domain_projection
checks.claim: The effective domain of a convex function is convex because it is the projection of the epigraph.
checks.evidence: The deck treats +infinity values as domain encoding and checks a domain-gap failure separately.

checks.name: hessian_psd_certificate
checks.claim: A twice differentiable function on an open convex set is convex when every Hessian is positive semidefinite.
checks.evidence: The quadratic example records Q positive semidefinite in the examples gallery.

checks.name: sublevel_sets_warning
checks.claim: Convex functions have convex sublevel sets, but convex sublevel sets alone do not imply convexity.
checks.evidence: convexity-failure-checks.json records f(x)=x^3 as a quasiconvex but nonconvex diagnostic.

checks.name: failure_gallery
checks.claim: Chord, domain, and sublevel diagnostics expose common false certificates.
checks.evidence: convexity-failure-checks.json has one passing convex chord check and three failures.
